# Bundled original fonts

These fonts are unmodified original upstream files. They retain their own SIL Open Font License 1.1, not the game's MIT license.

- **Smiley Sans / 得意黑 v2.0.1**: Copyright (c) 2022–2024 atelierAnchor. Reserved Font Names: Smiley, 得意黑. Original WOFF2 from https://github.com/atelier-anchor/smiley-sans/releases/download/v2.0.1/smiley-sans-v2.0.1.zip . Full license: SmileySans-OFL.txt. Original weight 400, style oblique. SHA-256: `731f22973349404b15a88a99ef3b5dd4104c0965c23b7e485c1f11e84fea99e2`.
- **Barlow Condensed Bold 1.408**: Copyright 2017 The Barlow Project Authors (https://github.com/jpt/barlow). Original TTF from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/60824dce48f7dd28fe7d65559f2da1f6e04e585b/ofl/barlowcondensed/BarlowCondensed-Bold.ttf . Full license: BarlowCondensed-OFL.txt. Weight 700, normal. SHA-256: `e476562ec9c1e16cf16475895b511f08c804f438cc9a9f80a44ea50a0eeb5b65`.

Both are served from this site. The offline HTML embeds the original bytes and complete license notices. System Chinese fonts remain the fallback for body text and player names. No font CDN is required.
